note: Regenerate metrics with `groundwork gate tests/golden/baseline.json --device cpu --record` only when a change is meant to move them, and commit the new values with that change.

gate-bm25.tolerance_basis: BM25 is exact integer counting and deterministic arithmetic: repeated runs on the development machine gave identical metrics (measured 24 Sep 2026), so any drop is a change.

gate-minilm.tolerance_basis: Fresh CPU encodes on the development machine were bit-identical (measured 24 Sep 2026). Other processors can round the last bits differently and swap near-tied chunks; that difference is measured on the first CI run and the tolerance set from it.
